    ▶ HOW TO PLAY

    HOW TO PLAY 1 / 2

    Every cycle has three phases. Five cycles, five rivals.

    ☾ NIGHTKill. Every victim fills your RAGE and is worth 1,000 × your kill chain (up to ×8). New special kills at LV 3 · 5 · 7.
    ☀ DAYHide. Touch a green-outlined object or jump into a manhole. Police dogs follow your scent.
    ☠ ARENAKill the rival. Life left, time and special kills become a bonus, a grade (S to C) and the family’s gifts.

    KEYBOARD · PAD

    • WASD ↑↓←→ move
    • J SPACE LEFT CLICK attack
    • K SHIFT RIGHT CLICK dash
    • 1–4 special kills
    • ESC pause · F full screen

    TOUCH

    • left half: touch and drag to move
    • big button, bottom right: attack
    • DASH: dash
    • named buttons: special kills (they fill up with rage)
    • II top right: pause

    THE HUD 2 / 2

    LVKILLS/HIDING TIME123456
    1. 1 · YOUR MONSTER red bar = life, orange bar = rage. LV = rage level.
    2. 2 · PHASE AND TIME NIGHT → DAY → ARENA. In the arena: the rival’s name and life.
    3. 3 · KILLS / HIDING TIME AND SCORE by day (ghost): seconds you stay hidden; at sunset each one is worth 3,000 points. At night and in the arena (skull): your KILLS, 1,000 points each × the kill chain shown at the bottom (up to ×8).
    4. 4 · HIDING SPOTS by day: how many spots you used today. Each one +3,000 and +3 health (up to +30 a day); it counts only if it’s at least 2 m from the last one. A spot works once, then it turns grey.
    5. 5 · BONE by day: green and blinking = ready. Press attack near a police dog: it runs for the bone and eats it, and can’t smell you meanwhile. It refills in 12 seconds.
    6. 6 · PAUSE resume, restart or exit; these boards, audio settings, records and NIGHTMARE.
